title: ishowspeed's top 10 gta 6 moments (aliens, demons and a kill room) 😳
hook: Speed went hunting for GTA 6's secrets and found aliens, demons and a whole lot of trouble.
intro: IShowSpeed spent one day of streams hunting for GTA 6's secrets. Not missions, not money. Secrets. And Leonida delivered. Aliens, demons, a bloody garage, and a man in an elevator wearing nothing but his boxer briefs. We went through every moment from that hunt, and these are the ten best. Speed's at full volume, so maybe turn yours down a little. Let's go.
outro: That's the hunt. Ten moments, one day, zero chill. All of this footage is from IShowSpeed's streams, so go show him some love, the link's in the description. And if you think we got the order wrong, tell me which one should've been number one. Subscribe, because Leonida is not done keeping secrets.

moments.label: the elevator encounter
moments.setup: Number ten. Speed's playing as Lucia. She steps into an elevator, and in walks Jason, wearing nothing but his boxer briefs. No explanation. No shame. Just vibes.
moments.react: Speed asking if he wants to fight the aliens naked is a genuinely fair question. And then they hug it out. Leonida is a strange place.

moments.label: crocodile fight
moments.setup: Number nine. Out in the marsh, Speed stumbles onto two crocodiles going at it. Most people would back away slowly. Speed pulls out his phone.
moments.react: World Star, he says, filming a crocodile fight on an in game phone. That might be the most Leonida thing that has ever happened.

moments.label: beach brawl
moments.setup: Number eight. A sunny day at the beach turns into a full brawl. Speed gets knocked straight off the pier, and then things go from bad to worse. But don't count him out yet.
moments.react: He got stomped, he got knocked off a pier, and he still found a way to win. That's not a fight, that's a comeback story.

moments.label: bigfoot hunt at night
moments.setup: Number seven. Night time, deep in the woods, flashlight on. Speed is hunting for Bigfoot. He finds a creepy carved figure in a tree, and then something starts chasing him. Is it Bigfoot? Keep watching.
moments.react: It was not Bigfoot. It was a very large, very angry pig. Speed went looking for a legend and got chased by bacon.

moments.label: chat trolls the safe code
moments.setup: Number six. Speed's stuck at a safe with a keypad and no code. So he does the one thing you should never do on a live stream. He asks chat for help.
moments.react: Six seven, six seven. Chat trolled him on the code, and you can feel his soul leave. Lesson learned: never trust chat with a safe.

moments.label: the kill room
moments.setup: Number five. Speed picks the lock on a random garage, because of course he does. Whatever's behind this door, nobody was supposed to find it.
moments.react: A cleaver, tools, and blood everywhere. Speed calls it Dexter Morgan's kill room, and honestly, he might be onto something. Rockstar loves a reference.

moments.label: the demon ritual
moments.setup: Number four. Now we're getting into the scary stuff. Speed finds a purple ritual room, and a man shows up acting very, very wrong. Watch Speed's face when it happens.
moments.react: His jaw hit the floor. A possessed man grabbing Lucia turns an easter egg hunt into a horror movie, and Speed did not sign up for a horror movie.

moments.label: demon rematch
moments.setup: Number three. The demon is back, and this time Speed came prepared. Round two. No running, no hiding.
moments.react: A fireball, a burning demon begging Lucia for help, and Speed showing absolutely zero mercy. Revenge, Leonida style.

moments.label: the alien wakes up
moments.setup: Number two. Remember the alien body? Speed found one earlier in the hunt, and now Lucia is holding one in her arms. It's not moving. Until it is.
moments.react: Its eyes open, and it floats right up into a UFO. An actual alien, in Lucia's arms, and then gone. Speed's easter egg hunt just went interstellar.

moments.label: the alien comes back
moments.setup: And number one. Right after the alien floats away, Speed and Lucia have company. Cars rolled up on them, and it looks like the end of the hunt. But somebody up there remembers who helped them.
moments.react: The UFO came back and blew up their cars. Did the alien just help me, he asks. Yes, Speed. Yes it did. Never judge a book by its cover, and never underestimate an alien you were nice to. That's number one.

about: IShowSpeed's GTA 6 easter egg hunt, his ten best moments ranked and narrated by us.
